episodes.title: The First Journalist Inside the Deadly Shakahola Forest – Francis Mtalaki | Maneeno Joint Ep. 8
episodes.description:
Francis Mtalaki is a respected Kenyan journalist whose work has gained recognition in Kenya and across Africa. Throughout his career, he has covered some of the country's most significant and challenging stories with courage and professionalism.

Among his most notable assignments was his coverage of the Shakahola tragedy, one of Kenya's deadliest cult-related disasters. Reporting from the scene, he brought national and international attention to the unfolding humanitarian crisis, helping the public understand the scale of the tragedy. His reporting played an important role in raising awareness and keeping the public informed as the Kenyan government conducted rescue operations, recovered victims, and launched investigations.

Francis Mtalaki's dedication to investigative and public-interest journalism continues to make a meaningful contribution to the media industry, demonstrating the vital role journalists play in uncovering the truth and serving the public
